description: Questions about the notebook itself, for about once a week: a prototype.

enabled.title: Questions about the notebook
enabled.description: A prototype: a Check-up at the end of the Exploration panel finds, with rules, what would stop a run from the top, slow cells and gaps. It calls an AI model only when you ask it to.

tabQuestion.title: The Check-up's icon on tabs
tabQuestion.description: Point at a notebook's tab to see the Check-up's icon, and click the icon to open the Check-up. It shows only while "Questions about the notebook" is on.
